news.headline: Research Reveals Significant Gaps in First Responder Training and Well-Being

paragraphs: Vector Solutions sells online training courses and the software to assign, track and report them, to schools and campuses, industrial employers, and fire, EMS and law enforcement agencies. For the fire service that means a training management system that tracks all training, EMS recerts, skill evaluations and ISO requirements in one place. Crews can accept callbacks and shifts from a mobile device, and a companion app handles truck checks, PPE inspections, controlled substance tracking and equipment maintenance. Law enforcement agencies get a training management system built around FTO/PTO and in-service training, plus POST and regulatory management, officer shift scheduling, policy management, BWC audits and accreditation management. A Professional Standards and Early Intervention tool gives agency leaders a way to manage performance and step in early.

In education, the company sells educator and staff training, a student safety and wellness program, and software to manage evaluations and professional development. Colleges get faculty and staff training, campus climate surveys built for VAWA compliance, and incident and EHS management. Industrial employers get a learning management system and course libraries in food safety, industrial skills, paper manufacturing, energy and HR compliance. Federal and military training management, fire marshal and POST training and compliance, and fire and law enforcement academy automation complete the list.
